environment.selection_rule: 2024 calendar-anchored starts Jan/Mar/May/Jul/Sep/Nov 1, exactly60d; earliest eligible in each weather class; no formation results read
environment.epoch_reason: First eligible active weather class; preregistered protocol.json
environment.inclination_reason: ISS-like 400 km Earth-observation plane; NASA reference, one illustrative orbit
environment.raan_reason: zero defines the reference inertial plane; not fitted to density or performance
environment.phase_reason: central satellite at ascending equator crossing at epoch
environment.geometry_assumptions: circular orbit; lambda interpreted as orbital phase plus fixed offset; fixed inclination/RAAN; ERA with UT1 approximated by UTC; no polar motion/precession/nutation/J2
environment.weather_interpolation: none; previous-day observed F107, centered81 F107, seven-component 3-hour Ap history
environment.cache_acceptance: short-case max/RMS errors within 1 percent or 0.05 m; sampled direct-density relative error below 0.001
